release_summary: KittyCombo gets tighter skill dispatch timing and action-row eligibility checks; the other addons carry over unchanged from 0.11.79.
runtime_validation: The full Lua 5.1 regression suite passed (477 tests), including focused KittyCombo checks for the dispatch window, action-slot eligibility, missing/zero mana resources, the in-range probe and prediction parity. In-game rotation timing and the comparison with the old 0.6 s window still need player confirmation.
